subject: Exemption certificate for Q4 invoice — Ohio nexus verification
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@blueridge-mfg.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Blue Ridge Manufacturing - AP <ap@blueridge-mfg.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Exemption documentation request for Q4 invoice

Hi Monica,

We're preparing payment for Redwood invoice INV-7932 (due Dec 3) but noticed sales tax was charged. Blue Ridge has resale exemption for Ohio (we have nexus there); I attached our reseller ST-1003 for your records. Can you confirm if Redwood can apply the exemption retroactively to INV-7932 and exclude sales tax from future invoices?

Notes: the attached PDF is our standard ST-1003 but it doesn't show our Ohio vendor registration number on the cover page — the registrar sent a separate confirmation email which I can forward if needed.

Attachments: BRM_initial_resale_ST-1003.pdf (resale certificate, unsigned copy)

Thanks,
Erin Cole
Accounts Payable
Blue Ridge Manufacturing
Phone: (513) 555-0147
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@blueridge-mfg.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exemption documentation request for Q4 invoice

Hi Erin — thanks for sending this over. Quick follow-ups so we can validate and apply the exemption:

1) We need a signed copy of the ST-1003 with the Ohio vendor registration number or a state-issued exemption confirmation (PDF).
2) Please confirm the legal entity name on the certificate matches the entity on the purchase order/invoice (Blue Ridge Manufacturing, LLC).
3) If you can provide the registry confirmation email (or a link) that shows the OH registration number, that will speed validation.

Once we receive the signed cert + registration number we'll run this through finance for retroactive credit on INV-7932. I'll also loop in Laura from Finance to expedite. If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, North America
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -05:00

Monica — attaching the corrected documents. We obtained the signed, state-stamped certificate and it includes the Ohio vendor registration number (BR-0427). I've attached the signed PDF and included the Ohio portal verification link below.

Attachments: BRM_ST-Exempt_OH_2026_signed.pdf (signed, state-stamped ST-1003)

Verification: https://ohio-tax-portal.gov/verify?reg=BRM-0427

Let me know if you need anything else. We'll need the credit posted before Dec 5 so our AP team can net it against next ACH run.

Thanks,
Erin
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Erin Cole <erin.cole@blueridge-mfg.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Exemption documentation request for Q4 invoice

Erin and Monica,

Thanks for the signed certificate — Finance validated the Ohio registration BR-0427 on the state portal and confirmed the entity name matches. We have approved a tax credit for invoice INV-7932 in the amount of $5,432.10 (sales tax line). I've attached a credit memo and applied the credit to the open invoice. Details:

- Invoice: INV-7932 (original amount $54,321.00)
- Credit memo: CM-7932-EX (attached INV-7932-credit-memo.pdf)
- Status: credit applied, balance updated in billing system

Next steps for AP: the credit is available to offset your next payment. If you'd prefer a refund instead of a credit, please confirm and we'll route to payments. We will retain the signed ST-1003 on file; note that Ohio requires renewal/confirmation every three years — we'll add a renewal reminder in our contract file 90 days before expiry.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Erin — confirmed on our end. Credit CM-7932-EX is live and will offset your next invoice; I added a note on the account with the expiration window and the state-reg number. Appreciate the quick turnaround on the signed certificate.

I also added a short process doc link for customers who want the credit issued as a refund instead of a credit memo: https://help.redwood.com/billing/credits-and-refunds

If anything else comes up, please loop me in. Happy holidays and best regards to the whole team at Blue Ridge.

Monica Patel
